title: Shopping is shifting to AI agents, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ). Walmart opened to outside AI agents, added spending limits; Amazon blocks them. Q3 PC shipments fell 21% (Counterpoint) amid memory-driven price inflation.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a shopping channel, and retailers set the rules
points.detail: Walmart lets outside agents buy with spending controls while Amazon blocks them; Amex built agent verification. Shoppers would send agents to marketplaces over brand sites, so our store must be agent-readable.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery step for shoppers
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery; Gartner says 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas. Product data quality and AI visibility now matter as much as SEO for us.

points.headline: PC demand is falling while memory costs push prices up
points.detail: Global PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 and Q4 is forecast to fall 27% (Counterpoint); memory shortage drives record PC price inflation. We should plan promotions, pricing and inventory for a weak Q4.

points.headline: Best Buy joins TikTok Shop for its biggest holiday season yet
points.detail: Marketplace and social channels are widening for electronics retailers. Adobe forecasts record $275.1B US online holiday sales, so we should weigh social commerce channels for Cyber 5.
